thesis: PRE-CLOSE (15:00 ET) read on Friday 2026-08-21, about an hour before the bell, positioning into the close and over the weekend. Structure first: the multi-month frame is intact and, if anything, firmer than the morning. SPY 765.22 keeps its deterministic 20>50>200 bull-stack (swing-structure-lab Bull-stacked, fast 760.99 over slow 707.13), +1.82% above its 50-day (~751.5) and +8.55% over its 200-day (~705.0), mom126/252 +11.58%/+21.25%, pctFrom52wHigh -1.63, so price is about 1.6% under its highs rather than a break, though swing-structure-lab still qualifies a Double top pattern and reads its own trend regime as unknown. The honest counterweight softened into the close: the dealer map is still negative gamma but has pulled back toward flat, signed net GEX -0.32B (from the morning's deeper -1.75B), the flip 765.59 with spot 765.41 sitting right beneath it, and crucially the put wall LIFTED to 765 (from 760) so it now sits at spot while the call wall holds 770, so dealers are pinning the tape into the 765/770 shelf rather than trapping it lower. The front expected move eased again to ±3.18 with atmIV 11.21% (from ±3.81 / 13.46%), in line with a VIX that eased to a calm 15.31. But intraday-tape-lab reads today's session a Reversal risk auction under Algo-controlled control (VWAP 765.73, gap +0.45%, 62 bars), so the late-day character carries two-way risk even as the levels compress. Breadth stays narrow: market-heatmap-lab reads 29.99% of 134 (narrow, margin -30.01); counting persistence by distinct market-bar dates the last three completed bars are 55.23% on 8/18, 64.33% on 8/19 and 29.99% on 8/20, so only one of the three cleared 60% and the latest is below the line. Flow is decidedly constructive by premium: options-flow-feed-lab reads call-heavy/leaning-bullish (callFraction 0.7406, call premium $2.347B against put premium $822.0M across 12 tickers, 1533 contracts over the $250k bar) with the most-unusual print a TSLA 360 CALL ($116.4M on 12.6x open interest, 0DTE), then an AMD 470 CALL and a GOOGL 345 CALL. The near-term leaders firmed but are not repaired: SPMO 148.88 is -1.31% below its 50-day (~150.8) while holding +13.87% over its 200-day (~130.8), QQQ 712.64 sits fractionally under its 50-day (~713.3, -0.1%, essentially back at the line) and XLK 183.04 is right at its 50-day (~183.0, +0.02%) but still Lagging. volatility-sizing-lab reads NORMAL (conditional vol 12.2052%, throttle x1.23). Leadership tilts toward energy and defensives (XLE at its 52-week high with the highest sector rsMom 102.24, XLV and XLB Leading, XLU/XLP/XLRE/XLC Improving, XLF weakening), the global tape is Asia-led (EWS Singapore 88.8 vs ACWI) and real-asset leadership is crypto-led (ETH-USD 74.2, BTC 71.6, GLD firmer at 49.7). Structure first, tactical noise last: HOLD the intact structural SPY/SPMO core and the first beta-add tranche while narrow breadth keeps the remaining tranches paused, tilt the sector book toward the Leading energy/healthcare and Improving defensives funded from weakening financials, HOLD (not chase) MSFT, and carry only a SMALL weekend tail while dealers stay negative under the flip and the intraday character reads reversal-risk.
